summary: Gold Royalty Corp., a Vancouver-based gold royalty and streaming company, furnished a Form 6-K containing its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, plus CEO and CFO certifications. Revenue rose to $10.2M for the quarter versus $4.1M a year earlier, with net income of $3.8M against a prior-year loss. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situations mechanics are disclosed; this is a routine quarterly reporting filing, so the special-situations read is neutral.
